mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comparison_report ( user_id, ai_recommended_property_id, title, compared_property_ids, ai_property_summary_text, ai_summary, saved, ai_atp, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{aiRecommendedPropertyId}, #{title}, CAST(#{comparedPropertyIdsJson} AS JSON), #{aiPropertySummaryText}, #{aiSummary}, 1, #{aiAtp}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id AS report_id, user_id, ai_recommended_property_id, title, CAST(compared_property_ids AS CHAR) AS compared_property_ids_json, ai_property_summary_text, ai_summary, ai_atp, created_at FROM comparison_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND saved = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id AS report_id, user_id, ai_recommended_property_id, title, CAST(compared_property_ids AS CHAR) AS compared_property_ids_json, ai_property_summary_text, ai_summary, ai_atp, created_at FROM comparison_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND saved = 1 AND JSON_LENGTH(compared_property_ids) = #{propertyCount} AND JSON_CONTAINS(compared_property_ids, CAST(#{propertyIdsJson} AS JSON)) AND JSON_CONTAINS(CAST(#{propertyIdsJson} AS JSON), compared_property_ids) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS report_id, user_id, ai_recommended_property_id, title, CAST(compared_property_ids AS CHAR) AS compared_property_ids_json, ai_property_summary_text, ai_summary, ai_atp, created_at FROM comparison_report WHERE id = #{reportId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND saved = 1
SELECT report_property.property_id FROM JSON_TABLE( #{propertyIdsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( sort_order FOR ORDINALITY, property_id BIGINT PATH '$' ) ) report_property ORDER BY report_property.sort_order

SELECT p.id AS property_id, p.title, p.property_type, p.trade_type, p.deposit, CASE WHEN p.trade_type = '월세' THEN p.monthly_rent END AS monthly_rent, p.maintenance_fee, p.area_m2, p.floor_info, p.update_date AS updated_date FROM JSON_TABLE( #{propertyIdsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( sort_order FOR ORDINALITY, property_id BIGINT PATH '$' ) ) report_property JOIN property p ON p.id = report_property.property_id ORDER BY report_property.sort_order
